claim: Robot-executed physical comparison of material sliding behaviour under controlled release conditions.

sources.supports: The public significance summary describes inclined-plane comparisons and chute-design relevance. G219 concerns static breakaway friction; this fixed-angle stopping-distance task is a different procedure.
Other permits additional domains informative about real-world impact, subject to the same importance criteria.

limit: No evidence establishes frequent performance of this exact test by occupations exceeding the jobs-impact threshold. This is not ASTM G219, a calibrated coefficient measurement, or a slip-safety certification. Importance under Other remains a reviewer judgment.
acceptance: Unreviewed local package; acceptance is not established
